_comment: Scenario battery for node 6a Haiku-slim, ported from node_6a_name_collection_self_scenarios.json (the production Qwen node's battery) at the user's explicit instruction to cover every guardrail the verbose version had. Each scenario keeps its original ID where the underlying requirement is unchanged; expected_behavior text is reworded where the old design used a numbered Qwen SIGNAL and the new design uses a named section or an inherited system-prompt block. Mechanism changed in several cases (e.g. INFO PIVOT / CONTACT CLINIC / CANCEL ESCAPE / WRAP-UP now come from nodes/shared/system_prompt.txt rather than a node-local signal) — the pass/fail criterion (what the caller should hear and which tool should fire) is preserved unchanged.

scenarios.name: S1 — EXECUTE produces speech and smart_voice_agent after email decline

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
Sarah Kowalski
So that's Sarah Kowalski — is that right?
Yes, that's right.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
No, I don't have one.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly 'One moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' (name confirmed, phone already known via caller_phone DV, email declined — all three resolved, EXECUTE fires in this same turn). FAIL if agent speaks without a smart_voice_agent tool call. FAIL if smart_voice_agent is called silently without the spoken phrase. FAIL if agent re-asks for email or asks any further question.

scenarios.name: S2 — Email-decline not recognised: agent re-asks instead of executing

history.content: I need to book in please.
What's your full name for the booking?
Tom Brennan
So that's Tom Brennan — is that right?
Yep.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
No.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'One moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' (plain 'No.' is read as email declined — email is resolved, all three fields resolved, EXECUTE fires). FAIL if agent asks 'Do you have an email address?' or similar again. FAIL if agent calls universal_router instead of smart_voice_agent.

scenarios.name: S3 — KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH: DV values injected, single caller message

history.content: [ElevenLabs DV state at node entry]: caller_first_name='Tracy', caller_last_name='Franklin-Briscoe', caller_email='tfranklinbriscoe@gmail.com'
Hi, yes go ahead and book me in.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' (KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH fires: caller_first_name, caller_last_name, caller_email all set, phone known via caller_phone). FAIL if agent asks 'What's your full name for the booking?' (ignored the known DV values). FAIL if smart_voice_agent is called silently with no spoken output.

scenarios.name: S4 — Correct tool on execute despite recent universal_router calls

history.content: Actually, can we change the time first?
Sure, let me update that.
[universal_router response]: {"intent": "change_time", "success": true}
Ok, I'm back. My name is Emma Fitzgerald.
So that's Emma Fitzgerald — is that right?
Yes.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
No thanks, skip it.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'One moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' (name confirmed, email declined, phone known — EXECUTE fires with the correct tool despite the recent universal_router call for change_time). FAIL if agent calls universal_router intent='book' or any other intent instead of smart_voice_agent. FAIL if no tool call is made at all.

scenarios.name: S5 — Post-booking constraint change: cancel+rebook via universal_router, not smart_voice_agent

history.content: Can I get a physio appointment please?
What's your full name for the booking?
James Oduya
So that's James Oduya — is that right?
Yes.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
james at gmail dot com
So that's J, A, M, E, S at gmail dot com — is that right?
Yes.
One moment.
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "message": "You're confirmed for Tuesday the 17th at 10 AM with Dr Singh at the city clinic."}
You're confirmed for Tuesday the 17th at 10 AM with Dr Singh at the city clinic.
Actually, can we do Wednesday instead?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'I'm sorry about that — let me cancel that booking and rebook you straight away.' AND calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with payload reschedule_mode=true (AFTER BOOKING SUCCEEDS' replacement-mention rule fires, not the system prompt's plain CANCEL ESCAPE). FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent (wrong tool). FAIL if agent asks 'What day would you prefer?' without making any tool call.

scenarios.name: S7 — NDIS coverage question mid name-collection routes to INFO PIVOT (inherited from system prompt)

history.content: I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
Actually wait, is this covered under NDIS?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='info_pivot' with called_number, caller_id in the same turn (the system prompt's INFO PIVOT block covers general clinic questions including NDIS/Medicare/coverage — this node has no local override for it). FAIL if agent fabricates an NDIS coverage answer directly. FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent instead of universal_router. FAIL if agent calls universal_router silently with no filler phrase. FAIL if agent asks 'What's your full name for the booking?' again without addressing the coverage question at all.

scenarios.name: S8 — Boundary: refund question fires node-local FINANCIAL ENQUIRY, not system-prompt INFO PIVOT

history.content: Hi, I want to book in.
What's your full name for the booking?
Before that — can I get a refund for my last visit?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Our team handles billing directly — would you like me to get someone to call you back?' (this node's FINANCIAL ENQUIRY block fires — refunds are billing-admin, not a coverage/rebate or plain-price question). FAIL if agent routes via universal_router intent='info_pivot' (scope creep — refunds are billing-admin, not general info). FAIL if agent fabricates a refund policy answer directly.

scenarios.name: S8b — Boundary: plain cost question now goes to the system prompt's PRICING QUERY, not FINANCIAL ENQUIRY (deliberate change from the Qwen version — see node6-haiku-slim-design.md)

history.content: Hi, I want to book in.
What's your full name for the booking?
Actually, how much does it cost?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent does NOT offer a billing callback for this — a plain cost question with appointment_type_id already resolved should go through the system prompt's PRICING QUERY (filler + universal_router intent='get_service_price'), per this node's FINANCIAL ENQUIRY block explicitly carving out plain-price questions. FAIL if agent says 'Our team handles billing directly — would you like me to get someone to call you back?' for a plain cost question (that response is reserved for invoices/refunds/payment-plan/outstanding-balance questions in this design).

scenarios.name: S9 — RESUMPTION after aside: no 'Now,' refocusing prefix

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
What's the cost fees?
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "price": "$160", "service": "Initial Consultation"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent's response states the price AND re-asks the pending name question in its original exact wording with no refocusing lead-in, e.g. 'The cost for the Initial Consultation is one hundred and sixty dollars. What's your full name for the booking?'. FAIL if the resumption is prefixed with 'Now,' or 'So,'. FAIL if the agent omits the pending name question entirely after answering the price.

scenarios.name: S11 — patient_name_raw already known skips name re-ask, asks email instead, no recap

history.content: Hi, this is Tanya Marshall calling to book in with Sean.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Do you have an email address for the booking?' directly (no booking recap before it) — patient_name_raw='Tanya Marshall' contains two tokens, name step is silent, this design never has a recap/APPOINTMENT CONFIRMATION block at all. FAIL if agent asks 'What's your full name for the booking?' or 'I just need your last name' (ignored patient_name_raw). FAIL if agent says any recap phrase like 'Perfect, 5 PM...' before the email question. FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn (name known, email not yet collected — no field resolved to book yet).

scenarios.name: S12 — Parking question mid name-collection routes to INFO PIVOT (inherited from system prompt), never fabricated

history.content: I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
Right. Where can I park?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='info_pivot' with called_number, caller_id in the same turn. FAIL if the agent fabricates any specific parking answer (e.g. describing free street parking) instead of routing to info_pivot — this is a known live-call hallucination risk. FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent instead of universal_router. FAIL if agent calls universal_router silently with no filler phrase. FAIL if agent asks 'What's your full name for the booking?' again without addressing the parking question at all.

scenarios.name: EC1 — Jukes/Dukes phonetic mismatch: silent-correct spelling from email, no clarifying question

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment. My name's Anthony Dukes.
So that's Anthony Dukes — is that right?
Yes, that's right.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
It's a, n, t, h, o, n, y, dot, j, u, k, e, s, at gmail dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent silently corrects the stored surname to 'Jukes' and proceeds directly to the email confirmation question, e.g. 'So that's anthony.jukes at gmail dot com — is that right?', with NO separate question raised about the Dukes/Jukes spelling discrepancy. FAIL if the agent asks a clarifying question like 'Is your last name spelled with a J or a D?' FAIL if the agent keeps 'Dukes' and never reconciles the mismatch at all.

scenarios.name: EC2 — Significant (3+ char) name/email mismatch still triggers the clarifying question, not silent-correction

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment. My name's Rebecca Sinclair.
So that's Rebecca Sinclair — is that right?
Yes.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
It's r, dot, montgomery, at outlook dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent asks a clarifying question noting the surname in the email ('Montgomery') doesn't match the surname given ('Sinclair'). FAIL if the agent silently overwrites 'Sinclair' with 'Montgomery' (or vice versa) without asking. FAIL if the agent ignores the mismatch entirely and proceeds straight to execute.

scenarios.name: AG1 — Spelling-confidence gate fires on sound-alike pair (Cain/Kane)

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book in please. My last name's Cain.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent asks a spelling-confirmation question distinguishing the two spellings, e.g. 'Is that C-A-I-N or K-A-N-E?' (Cain/Kane is explicitly listed as a sound-alike pair). FAIL if the agent assumes one spelling without confirming which. FAIL if the agent asks for the full name again instead of a targeted spelling question.

scenarios.name: EP1 — Affirmative 'yeah' to email question triggers 'What is it?' not silence

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
John Smith
Do you have an email address for the booking?
Yeah.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks for the actual email address, e.g. 'What is it?'. FAIL if agent goes silent, says something unrelated, or immediately calls smart_voice_agent (email step is not resolved — 'yeah' confirms having an email but doesn't provide one). FAIL if agent repeats 'Do you have an email address?' verbatim. FAIL if agent calls any tool this turn.

scenarios.name: PFX1 — Email local-part prefix near-miss (ele vs Elie): triggers 'I have your name down as' template

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
My full name is Elie, that's E-L-I-E, and my last name is Nol.
So that's Elie Nol — is that right?
Yes, correct.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
Yeah, it's ele dot nol two two two two at gmail dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent uses the near-miss template, e.g. 'Just to make sure — I have your name down as Elie, so that's E, L, E, dot, N, O, L, two, two, two, two at gmail dot com — is that right?'. FAIL if agent reads back with the plain 'So that's...' template with no mismatch highlighted. FAIL if agent skips the email readback entirely.

scenarios.name: ERR1 — EXECUTE RECOVERY: prior turn said 'One moment.' with no tool call; caller silent; agent retries the tool call now

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
Elie Nol
So that's Elie Nol — is that right?
Yes, correct.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
elie.nol2222 at gmail dot com
Just to make sure — I have your name down as Elie, so that's E, L, I, E, dot, N, O, L, two, two, two, two at gmail dot com — is that right?
Yes, correct.
One moment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' in this turn with spoken output 'One moment.' — EXECUTE's RECOVERY check fires because the prior agent turn said 'One moment.' with no smart_voice_agent response since, and name+email are both resolved. FAIL if agent says 'Hello, are you still there?' or any generic dead-air phrase (the system prompt's default DEAD AIR handling fired instead of RECOVERY). FAIL if agent calls universal_router instead of smart_voice_agent. FAIL if agent makes no tool call at all.

scenarios.name: ERR2 — EXECUTE RECOVERY fires on 'ok', not just silence — distinguishes RECOVERY from the generic wait phrase

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
Elie Nol
And could you spell your last name for me?
N, O, L
So that's N, O, L — is that right?
Yes.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
No, I don't have one.
One moment.
ok

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' with spoken output 'One moment.' — RECOVERY fires because the prior agent turn said 'One moment.' with no tool response since, and name+phone+email are all resolved. The trigger is 'ok', not silence — this validates RECOVERY isn't scoped only to the system prompt's bare check-in phrases. FAIL if agent says any generic acknowledgement with no tool call. FAIL if agent calls universal_router instead of smart_voice_agent.

scenarios.name: WUP1 — Booking confirmation: wrap_up called in the same response as the booking message, not after caller speaks

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
Elie Nol
So that's Elie Nol — is that right?
Yes.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
elie.nol2222 at gmail dot com
Just to make sure — I have your name down as Elie, so that's E, L, I, E, dot, N, O, L, two, two, two, two at gmail dot com — is that right?
Yes.
One moment.
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "message": "Wonderful Elie! You're confirmed for Monday, July twenty-seventh at two PM. See you then!"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks the message field verbatim AND calls universal_router intent='wrap_up' in the SAME response, without waiting for the caller to say anything. FAIL if agent speaks the booking message but does NOT call wrap_up in the same turn. FAIL if agent calls wrap_up silently without speaking the message. FAIL if agent alters or adds to the message field text.

scenarios.name: EP2 — Email patience: two confused replies in a row triggers the skip offer

history.content: Hi, I need to book please.
What's your full name for the booking?
John Miller
Do you have an email address for the booking?
Yeah.
What is it?
What's that?
What email address would you like to use for the booking?
What's that?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent offers to skip the email after two confused replies in a row, e.g. 'No problem if you don't have one — shall I skip the email for now?'. FAIL if agent asks for the email address a third time without offering the skip. FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent (email step isn't resolved yet — the skip offer must be accepted first). FAIL if agent interprets 'What's that?' as a decline and calls smart_voice_agent without offering the skip.

scenarios.name: AC1 — After name collected: email question only, no booking recap

history.content: What's your full name for the booking?
Matthew Sparks.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks ONLY 'Do you have an email address for the booking?' (or first spell-checks the last name, then asks for email) with NO booking recap before it. FAIL if agent says any recap phrase like 'Perfect, 11 AM Friday the 31st with Milan at Alpine Osteopaths.' before the email question. FAIL if agent asks 'What's your full name for the booking?' again. FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn (name just resolved, email not yet — not all three resolved).

scenarios.name: CE1 — All DVs set (name + email on file): KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH executes directly, no recap, no email question

history.content: Yeah go ahead and book me in.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' — KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH fires because caller_first_name, caller_last_name, and caller_email are all set. FAIL if agent says any recap phrase before executing. FAIL if agent asks 'Do you have an email address for the booking?'. FAIL if smart_voice_agent is called silently without the spoken phrase.

scenarios.name: NCZ1 — No tool call between name confirmation and the next question

history.content: Hi, I need to book a physio appointment.
What is your full name for the booking?
Sarah Ballesteros
So that is S, A, R, A, H, B, A, L, L, E, S, T, E, R, O, S — is that right?
Yes, that is correct.
Perfect. What is your email address?

scenarios.expected_behavior: The agent turn that asked for email must contain zero tool calls — no capture_context, no universal_router, no smart_voice_agent call of any kind between the name confirmation and the email question (email is not yet resolved, so EXECUTE cannot fire; nothing else in this design has a reason to call a tool here). A tool call in that transition turn is a protocol violation.

scenarios.name: LS1 — Last name always spell-checked: agent asks even when it sounds unambiguous

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
Diane Gatenby

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks the caller to spell their last name, e.g. 'And could you spell your last name for me?'. FAIL if agent says 'So that's Diane Gatenby — is that right?' without asking for spelling — this is the exact live bug where 'Gatenby' was transcribed as 'Gaytonby' and confirmed incorrectly. FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn.

scenarios.name: LS2 — Last-name spell rule applies to common names too: 'Smith' must still be spelled

history.content: Hi, I need to book in. My name is John Smith.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'And could you spell your last name for me?'. FAIL if agent says 'So that's John Smith — is that right?' and moves straight to email — the last-name spell rule has no exception for common surnames. FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn.

scenarios.name: LS3 — Spelled last name read back letter by letter before moving on

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
Diane Gatenby
And could you spell your last name for me?
G, A, T, E, N, B, Y

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent reads back the spelling letter by letter, e.g. 'So that's G, A, T, E, N, B, Y — is that right?' and waits for confirmation before asking for email. FAIL if agent skips the readback and immediately asks for email. FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn.

scenarios.name: PC1 — phone not known: PRE-COLLECTION does not resolve it, phone question fires after name

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
James Holt
So that's James Holt — is that right?
Yes, that's right.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'And what's a good number to reach you on?' (phone not resolved — both caller_phone-equivalent DVs are empty). FAIL if agent asks 'Do you have an email address for the booking?' (skipped the phone question when phone was genuinely unknown). FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn (email not yet asked, not all three resolved).

scenarios.name: PC2 — phone already known via system__caller_id: phone question skipped, straight to email

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
James Holt
So that's James Holt — is that right?
Yes, that's right.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Do you have an email address for the booking?' (phone resolved via system__caller_id, PRE-COLLECTION skips the phone question). FAIL if agent asks 'And what's a good number to reach you on?' (phone question incorrectly fired when it was already known). FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn.

scenarios.name: PC3 — phone already known via caller_id fallback (system__caller_id empty): phone question skipped

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
James Holt
And could you spell your last name for me?
H, O, L, T
So that's H, O, L, T — is that right?
Yes, that's right.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Do you have an email address for the booking?' — PRE-COLLECTION resolves phone from {{caller_id}} when {{caller_phone}}/system__caller_id is empty. FAIL if agent asks 'And what's a good number to reach you on?'. FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn.

scenarios.name: PC4 — anonymous caller: phone question fires despite a non-empty but 'anonymous' phone DV

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
Kim Gatenby
And could you spell your last name for me?
G, A, T, E, N, B, Y
So that's G, A, T, E, N, B, Y — is that right?
Yes.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'And what's a good number to reach you on?' — PRE-COLLECTION treats 'anonymous' as equivalent to empty, not a real phone number. FAIL if agent asks 'Do you have an email address for the booking?' (treated 'anonymous' as a known phone number). FAIL if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' and calls smart_voice_agent (KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH must not treat 'anonymous' as known phone). FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn.

scenarios.name: FT1 — First turn, name unknown: no recap, directly asks for name

history.content: Yeah eleven should work.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'What's your full name for the booking?' with NO booking recap before it — this design never has a recap block, the very first response must go straight to name collection. FAIL if agent says ANY recap phrase such as 'Perfect, 11 AM Saturday the 1st with Hannah at Luminance Health.' before asking for the name — callers hearing a recap this early think the booking is done and hang up. FAIL if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' without a smart_voice_agent tool call (KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH must not fire — caller_first_name and caller_last_name are both empty). FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn.

scenarios.name: KE1 — known phone (system__caller_id empty, caller_id set) + email on file + patient_name_raw: EXECUTE fires immediately after last name confirmed, in the same turn

history.content: And could you spell your last name for me?
M, U, R, P, H, Y
So that's M, U, R, P, H, Y — is that right?
Yeah

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'One moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' — name just confirmed this turn, phone already known via caller_id, email already known via caller_email — all three resolved in this same turn, EXECUTE fires immediately (the same-turn cascade this design's EXECUTE section describes). FAIL if agent asks 'And what's a good number to reach you on?' (phone incorrectly treated as unknown). FAIL if agent asks 'Do you have an email address for the booking?' (email incorrectly treated as unknown). FAIL if smart_voice_agent is called silently without spoken output. FAIL if agent calls universal_router instead of smart_voice_agent.

scenarios.name: KE2 — known phone (caller_id) + email on file: EXECUTE fires immediately after last name confirmed

history.content: And could you spell your last name for me?
A, N, D, E, R, S, O, N
So that's A, N, D, E, R, S, O, N — is that right?
Yes, that's right.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'One moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book'. FAIL if agent asks for phone or email (both already known). FAIL if smart_voice_agent is called silently. FAIL if agent calls universal_router instead.

scenarios.name: KE3 — email on file but phone NOT known: after name confirm, ask phone, do not execute

history.content: And could you spell your last name for me?
H, O, L, T
So that's H, O, L, T — is that right?
Yes.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'And what's a good number to reach you on?' — phone is not resolved (both caller_phone and caller_id are empty), so EXECUTE cannot fire yet even though name and email are both resolved. FAIL if agent speaks 'One moment.' and calls smart_voice_agent (phone was not actually known). FAIL if agent asks for email (already known — only phone is outstanding). FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn.

scenarios.name: SPK1 — 'Can I speak to the practitioner' now handled by the system prompt's CONTACT CLINIC (behaviour change from the old node-local SPEAK TO PRACTITIONER signal — see node6-haiku-slim-design.md)

history.content: I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
Actually, can I speak to Dr Nguyen directly?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent states the transfer limitation and moves toward taking a message, per the system prompt's CONTACT CLINIC block (e.g. 'I'm not able to transfer your call to reception, but I can pass on a message for them to call you back.' then asking for name/message as needed) — no node-local override exists for this in the new design, it flows through the shared block. FAIL if agent fabricates a transfer or claims it's connecting the call. FAIL if agent silently ignores the request and re-asks for the booking name.
